method: git archive HEAD to isolated temporary directory; symlink existing node_modules; run typecheck, build, default tests sequentially; then copy two ignored local fixtures and rerun observe-kimi only
commands: node --test --test-timeout=120000 --import <same electron-stub loader as package.json> tests/observe-kimi.test.mjs
